fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-12-03, around 14:35, the complainant was stopped by a group near Kayal Puram Highway Junction, and a mobile phone along with cash of around Rs. 3,000 were taken under threat, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-12-03. Uma Bai (9000000465), described as a driver, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Gopal Natarajan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000030. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects reportedly approached in a secluded stretch and left quickly.
fields.Keywords: robbery, threat, afternoon, highway junction, associate, suspect, CCTV, mobile number
